recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl
Add milk and whisk together
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat
Pour egg mixture in and stir gently
Season with salt and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use leftover egg shells as plant fertilizer

recipes.name: Spinach & Egg Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt
Heat olive oil and saute garlic until fragrant
Add spinach and cook until wilted
Pour eggs over the spinach and cook on low heat until set
Fold the omelette in half and serve warm
recipes.sustainability_tip: Spinach stems are edible — chop and cook them too instead of discarding

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente
Saute garlic in olive oil until golden
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer into a sauce
Toss the drained pasta into the sauce
Stir in fresh basil off the heat and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe tomatoes work great here — don't throw them out

recipes.name: Chicken Stir Fry
steps: Slice chicken breast into thin strips
Heat oil in a wok over high heat
Stir-fry chicken until browned
Add bell pepper, onion and garlic, stir-fry 2 minutes
Pour in soy sauce, toss to coat and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Save chicken bones and vegetable scraps for a homemade stock

recipes.name: Green Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend spinach, banana, milk and honey until smooth
Pour into a bowl
Top with your favourite fruit and seeds
Serve immediately
recipes.sustainability_tip: Freeze overripe bananas instead of tossing them

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice and let it cool (day-old rice works best)
Scramble the egg in a hot wok and set aside
Saute garlic and onion until fragrant
Add carrot and stir-fry until tender
Add rice, soy sauce and egg, stir-fry until combined
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use leftover rice and vegetable odds and ends to avoid waste

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Dice and cook chicken breast until golden, set aside
Scramble the egg and set aside
Saute garlic and onion in the same pan
Add cooked rice and break up any clumps
Return chicken and egg to the pan, add soy sauce and toss together
recipes.sustainability_tip: This is a great way to use up leftover rice and cooked chicken

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
steps: Pat shrimp dry and season with salt
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat
Add garlic and cook until fragrant
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink
Squeeze lemon juice over the top and garnish with parsley
recipes.sustainability_tip: Keep shrimp shells to make a quick seafood stock

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the ground beef with diced onion
Season with cumin, paprika and salt
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill tortillas with beef, tomato, cheese and lettuce
Serve with lime wedges
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use vegetable trimmings from onion and tomato in a stock bag in the freezer

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Grill or pan-sear the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice
Cube bread and toast in olive oil to make croutons
Toss lettuce with caesar dressing
Top with chicken, croutons and shaved parmesan
Serve immediately
recipes.sustainability_tip: Stale bread makes the best croutons — don't throw it out

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface
Spread a thin layer of crushed tomato sauce
Top with torn mozzarella
Bake at high heat until the crust is golden and cheese bubbles
Finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil
recipes.sustainability_tip: Freeze extra dough portions instead of making a whole batch at once

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter until soft
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned
Stir in rice and toast for a minute
Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed
Finish with parmesan and a knob of butter
recipes.sustainability_tip: Mushroom stems and trimmings can go straight into the stock pot

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C
Place salmon and chopped vegetables on a tray
Drizzle with olive oil, salt and pepper
Bake for 15-18 minutes until salmon flakes easily
Squeeze lemon over the top before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Save the lemon peel to make citrus-infused water or zest for baking

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Saute onion, garlic and carrot until fragrant
Add chicken and stock, bring to a simmer
Cook until chicken is tender, then shred it
Add noodles and cook until tender
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use the chicken carcass to make stock instead of buying it

recipes.name: Tomato Soup
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter until soft
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes
Blend until smooth
Stir in a splash of milk for creaminess
Season and serve with crusty bread
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe or blemished tomatoes are perfect for soup

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread
Place cheese between the slices, buttered sides out
Grill in a pan over medium heat until golden
Flip and cook the other side until cheese melts
Slice and serve warm
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use the heel/end slices of a loaf here — they work perfectly

recipes.name: Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar and a pinch of salt together
Add egg and milk, whisk until smooth
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat
Pour batter and cook until bubbles form, then flip
Cook the other side until golden and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Batter keeps well overnight in the fridge — make only what you'll eat

recipes.name: French Toast
steps: Whisk egg, milk and cinnamon together
Dip bread slices in the mixture, soaking both sides
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat
Fry the soaked bread until golden on both sides
Serve with syrup or fruit
recipes.sustainability_tip: This is the perfect way to use up bread that's gone slightly stale

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana in a bowl
Whisk in egg and milk
Fold in flour until just combined
Cook spoonfuls of batter in a lightly greased pan until golden
Flip and cook the other side, then serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe, spotty bananas make the sweetest pancakes

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt
Spread over the toast
Top with chili flakes or an egg if desired
Serve immediately
recipes.sustainability_tip: Keep the avocado pit in the mash to slow browning if not eating right away

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
steps: Saute onion, garlic and ginger until fragrant
Add curry powder and cook for a minute
Add chicken and brown lightly
Pour in coconut milk and simmer until chicken is cooked through
Serve hot with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Freeze leftover coconut milk in ice cube trays for future use

recipes.name: Beef Stir Fry
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain
Stir-fry beef in a hot wok until browned, set aside
Stir-fry broccoli and carrot until crisp-tender
Return beef to the wok with garlic and soy sauce
Toss everything together and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Broccoli stalks are edible — peel and slice them thin instead of discarding

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat
Add garlic and stir-fry until fragrant
Add broccoli, carrot and bell pepper
Stir-fry until vegetables are crisp-tender
Add soy sauce, toss and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use any vegetables that need using up — this recipe is very flexible

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Saute onion and bell pepper until soft
Add garlic and cumin, cook until fragrant
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer into a thick sauce
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them
Cover and cook until the eggs are set, then serve with bread
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up soft or overripe tomatoes and peppers

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the egg in a hot wok and set aside
Saute garlic and onion until fragrant
Add rice and break up any clumps
Return the egg to the wok and add soy sauce
Toss everything together and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: The classic way to use up leftover rice before it goes to waste

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Saute onion, garlic and carrot until soft
Add ground beef and brown thoroughly
Stir in chopped tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes
Boil pasta until al dente
Serve the sauce over the pasta with grated cheese
recipes.sustainability_tip: Simmer longer with vegetable scraps for extra flavor before straining

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil pasta until al dente, reserving some pasta water
Cook bacon until crisp
Whisk egg with grated parmesan and black pepper
Toss hot pasta with bacon off the heat, then quickly stir in the egg mixture
Add a splash of pasta water to loosen the sauce and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Save pasta water — its starch is great for thickening sauces

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Flatten chicken breasts to an even thickness
Dip in egg, then coat in bread crumbs mixed with parmesan
Pan-fry until golden on both sides
Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella
Bake until the cheese melts and serve with pasta
recipes.sustainability_tip: Stale bread makes excellent homemade bread crumbs

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds
Arrange alternating on a plate
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices
Drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of salt
Serve immediately
recipes.sustainability_tip: Ripe, in-season tomatoes taste best and reduce food miles

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber and onion into chunks
Combine in a bowl with crumbled feta
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon
Season with oregano, salt and pepper
Toss gently and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use slightly soft cucumbers and tomatoes here — they still taste great chopped

recipes.name: Potato Soup
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter until soft
Add diced potatoes and stock, simmer until tender
Blend partially for a creamy but chunky texture
Stir in milk and heat through
Season and serve with chives
recipes.sustainability_tip: Potato skins are nutritious — leave them on when possible

recipes.name: Roasted Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C
Chop vegetables into even chunks
Toss with olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper
Roast for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway
Serve as a side or over rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: This is the perfect recipe for odds and ends of vegetables nearing their expiry

recipes.name: Beef Stew
steps: Brown beef chunks in a large pot
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft
Add potato, carrot and stock
Simmer covered for 1.5-2 hours until beef is tender
Season to taste and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Tougher, cheaper cuts of beef work beautifully in a long-simmered stew

recipes.name: Chicken Soup with Rice
steps: Saute onion, garlic and carrot until fragrant
Add chicken and stock, bring to a simmer
Cook until chicken is tender, then shred
Add rice and cook until tender
Season and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use the chicken carcass for stock instead of store-bought

recipes.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
steps: Hard boil the eggs, then cool and peel
Chop the eggs and mix with mayonnaise and mustard
Season with salt and pepper
Spread onto bread slices
Slice and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Eggshells can be crushed and added to compost or garden soil

recipes.name: Tuna Salad
steps: Drain the tuna well
Mix with mayonnaise, finely diced onion and a squeeze of lemon
Season with salt and pepper
Serve on bread, crackers or over greens
recipes.sustainability_tip: Choose pole-and-line caught tuna where possible for sustainable fishing

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Breast
steps: Marinate chicken in olive oil, garlic and lemon juice for 20 minutes
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high
Grill chicken 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing
Serve with a side salad or vegetables
recipes.sustainability_tip: Marinate in a reusable container instead of a disposable bag

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Thighs
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C
Rub chicken thighs with olive oil, garlic and paprika
Place skin-side up on a baking tray
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden and cooked through
Rest for a few minutes before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Save the rendered fat and pan juices to flavor rice or vegetables

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
steps: Saute onion, garlic and ginger until fragrant
Add curry powder and cook for a minute
Add potato and carrot, stir to coat
Pour in coconut milk and simmer until vegetables are tender
Serve hot with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Root vegetables nearing the end of their shelf life are perfect here

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrot and garlic until soft
Add lentils, chopped tomato and stock
Simmer for 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender
Blend partially if a creamier texture is desired
Season and serve with bread
recipes.sustainability_tip: Lentils are a low-water-footprint protein — a great sustainable staple

recipes.name: Chickpea Salad
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas
Chop tomato, cucumber and onion
Combine everything in a bowl
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Toss and serve chilled or at room temperature
recipes.sustainability_tip: Canned chickpeas keep well and reduce fresh produce waste

recipes.name: Fried Egg Rice Bowl
steps: Cook rice and place in a bowl
Fry an egg sunny-side up
Place the fried egg on top of the rice
Drizzle with soy sauce and top with sliced green onion
Mix everything together and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: A simple, quick meal that uses just one egg and pantry basics

recipes.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel and chop the potatoes into even chunks
Boil until fork-tender
Drain and return to the pot
Mash with butter and warm milk until smooth
Season with salt and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Potato peels can be roasted into crispy chips instead of thrown away

recipes.name: Garlic Bread
steps: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and chopped parsley
Slice the bread and spread the garlic butter generously
Wrap in foil or place on a tray
Bake at 180C for 10 minutes until warm and toasted
Serve alongside pasta or soup
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great use for a baguette that's starting to go stale

recipes.name: Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Sprinkle cheese over half of a tortilla
Fold the tortilla in half
Cook in a buttered pan until golden and cheese melts
Flip carefully and cook the other side
Slice into wedges and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use up small amounts of leftover cheese ends here

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
steps: Cook diced chicken with onion and bell pepper until done
Sprinkle cheese and the chicken mixture over half a tortilla
Fold and cook in a pan until golden on both sides
Cheese should be fully melted
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa
recipes.sustainability_tip: Great way to use up small amounts of leftover cooked chicken

recipes.name: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt
Saute diced bell pepper, onion and tomato until soft
Pour the eggs over the vegetables in the pan
Sprinkle cheese on top and cook until set
Fold and serve warm
recipes.sustainability_tip: A perfect way to use small amounts of leftover vegetables

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C
Pierce the sweet potato a few times with a fork
Bake for 40-45 minutes until soft
Slice open and add a knob of butter
Season with salt and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Sweet potato skins are edible and packed with fiber — no need to peel

recipes.name: Stir Fried Broccoli with Garlic
steps: Cut broccoli into florets
Heat oil in a pan and add garlic
Add broccoli and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes
Add a splash of water and cover briefly to steam
Finish with soy sauce and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Peel and slice the broccoli stalk thin to cook alongside the florets

recipes.name: Tomato Egg Stir Fry
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt
Scramble the eggs in a hot pan and set aside
Stir-fry chopped tomatoes until they release their juices
Return the eggs to the pan and toss together
Garnish with green onion and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: A classic quick dish for tomatoes that are a little too soft to eat raw

recipes.name: Banana Oat Smoothie
steps: Add banana, oats, milk and honey to a blender
Blend until smooth
Add ice if a colder, thicker texture is desired
Pour into a glass and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe bananas blend even sweeter — don't toss them

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread
Spread a generous layer of peanut butter
Top with sliced banana
Drizzle with honey if desired and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use up bananas that are just starting to brown

recipes.name: Chicken Sandwich
steps: Season and grill or pan-sear the chicken breast until cooked through
Toast the bread lightly
Spread mayonnaise on the bread
Layer chicken, lettuce and tomato
Close the sandwich, slice and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Leftover roast chicken works perfectly here instead of cooking fresh

recipes.name: Fruit Salad
steps: Chop all the fruit into bite-sized pieces
Combine in a large bowl
Drizzle with honey and a squeeze of lemon juice to prevent browning
Toss gently and chill before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up fruit that's a little too soft for eating on its own

recipes.name: Cucumber Yogurt Salad
steps: Grate or thinly slice the cucumber
Mix with yogurt and minced garlic
Add chopped mint and a pinch of salt
Chill for 10 minutes before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: A refreshing side that uses up cucumbers before they turn soft

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
steps: Boil the pasta until just shy of al dente
Mix with tomato sauce, ricotta and garlic
Transfer to a baking dish and top with mozzarella
Bake at 190C until bubbling and golden
Rest for 5 minutes before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Freezes well — make a double batch to reduce future cooking energy use

recipes.name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrot and celery until soft
Add chicken and stock, bring to a simmer
Add diced potato and cook until tender
Shred the cooked chicken and return to the pot
Season and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Vegetable ends (celery leaves, carrot tops) can flavor the broth too

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Season and sear chicken thighs until golden
Mix honey, minced garlic and soy sauce
Pour the sauce over the chicken in the pan
Simmer until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken
Serve with rice and steamed vegetables
recipes.sustainability_tip: Local honey supports local beekeepers and pollinators

recipes.name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water until pliable
Stir-fry tofu and shrimp until cooked, push to one side
Crack in the egg and scramble it into the pan
Add noodles, bean sprouts and pad thai sauce, toss to combine
Top with crushed peanuts and a squeeze of lime
recipes.sustainability_tip: Shrimp shells can be frozen and saved for stock instead of discarded

recipes.name: Green Curry Chicken
steps: Fry green curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant
Add chicken and cook until browned
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and bring to a simmer
Add eggplant and cook until tender
Stir in fish sauce and basil leaves, serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Freeze leftover curry paste in small portions to use only what you need

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
steps: Bring stock to a boil with lemongrass and chili
Add mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes
Add shrimp and cook until just pink
Season with fish sauce and lime juice
Garnish with cilantro and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use the whole mushroom, including stems, to reduce food waste

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
steps: Mince the chicken breast or use ground chicken
Stir-fry garlic and chili in hot oil until fragrant
Add chicken and cook until browned
Add soy sauce and toss in thai basil off the heat
Serve over rice with a fried egg on top
recipes.sustainability_tip: A fast weeknight dish that helps use up basil before it wilts

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Soak glutinous rice and steam until tender
Warm coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt
Pour most of the coconut milk over the hot rice and let it absorb
Slice the mango
Serve rice topped with mango and the remaining coconut sauce
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe mango works perfectly and tastes even sweeter here

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized cubes
Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until browned
Add garlic, chili and bell pepper, stir-fry briefly
Add soy sauce and toss to coat
Stir in roasted peanuts and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Buy peanuts in bulk to cut down on packaging waste

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Cut pork into chunks and fry until golden and cooked through
Stir-fry bell pepper until just tender
Mix vinegar, sugar and soy sauce to make the sauce
Add pineapple and the sauce to the pan, simmer until thickened
Return pork to the pan, toss to coat and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use canned pineapple in juice rather than syrup to reduce added sugar waste

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Cut tofu into cubes and set aside
Brown the ground pork in a hot pan
Add garlic and chili bean paste, cook until fragrant
Add tofu and a splash of stock, simmer gently for 5 minutes
Garnish with green onion and serve over rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Tofu is a low-water, low-carbon protein — a sustainable swap for meat

recipes.name: Chinese Fried Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until just tender, then drain
Scramble the egg in a hot wok and set aside
Stir-fry garlic, cabbage and carrot until crisp-tender
Add noodles and soy sauce, toss to combine
Return the egg to the wok and mix through before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Odds and ends of cabbage and carrot work perfectly in this flexible dish

recipes.name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Bring stock to a simmer with sliced mushrooms
Add diced tofu and cook for a few minutes
Season with vinegar, soy sauce and white pepper
Drizzle in beaten egg while stirring to form ribbons
Serve hot, adjusting sourness and spice to taste
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up odd bits of mushroom and tofu before they spoil

recipes.name: Char Siu Chicken
steps: Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic and five spice into a marinade
Marinate chicken thighs for at least 20 minutes
Roast or grill at high heat, basting with marinade
Cook until caramelized and cooked through, about 20 minutes
Rest briefly, slice and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Marinate in a reusable bowl covered with a plate instead of cling film

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, garlic and ginger into a sauce
Sear chicken thighs skin-side down until golden
Flip and cook through
Pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy and thickened
Slice and serve over rice with the sauce spooned on top
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use bone-in thighs and save the bones for a quick stock

recipes.name: Miso Soup
steps: Bring water or dashi to a gentle simmer
Whisk in miso paste until dissolved (do not boil)
Add cubed tofu and seaweed, warm through
Garnish with sliced green onion
Serve immediately as a starter or side
recipes.sustainability_tip: Miso paste keeps for months in the fridge — buy once, use often

recipes.name: Salmon Onigiri
steps: Cook rice and season lightly with salt
Flake cooked or canned salmon
Wet hands and shape rice around a spoonful of salmon into a triangle
Wrap a strip of seaweed around the base
Serve at room temperature or pack for later
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to repurpose small amounts of leftover cooked salmon

recipes.name: Yaki Udon
steps: Cook udon noodles according to packet instructions and drain
Stir-fry sliced pork until browned
Add cabbage and carrot, stir-fry until tender
Add noodles and soy sauce, toss everything together
Serve hot straight from the wok
recipes.sustainability_tip: Fresh udon freezes well — buy in bulk to reduce packaging trips

recipes.name: Japanese Curry
steps: Brown chicken pieces in a large pot
Add onion, carrot and potato, cook briefly
Cover with water and simmer until vegetables are tender
Break in curry roux blocks and stir until dissolved and thickened
Simmer a few more minutes and serve over rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: A one-pot meal that's perfect for using up root vegetables before they soften

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap
steps: Cook rice and place in a bowl
Blanch spinach and bean sprouts separately, season lightly
Saute julienned carrot until just tender
Fry an egg sunny-side up
Arrange vegetables and egg over rice, top with gochujang and mix before eating
recipes.sustainability_tip: A flexible dish — swap in whatever vegetables need using up

recipes.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain
Mix soy sauce, garlic, sugar and sesame oil into a marinade
Marinate beef for at least 20 minutes
Sear beef in a hot pan until caramelized
Garnish with green onion and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Thin-sliced cheaper beef cuts work just as well as premium cuts here

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Chop kimchi and stir-fry until slightly caramelized
Add rice and break up any clumps
Season with soy sauce and a splash of kimchi juice
Fry an egg sunny-side up separately
Top the rice with the fried egg and sliced green onion
recipes.sustainability_tip: The classic way to use up rice and kimchi before they go past their best

recipes.name: Korean Spicy Chicken
steps: Mix gochujang with garlic and a little sugar for the sauce
Toss chicken pieces in the sauce
Stir-fry chicken until browned
Add cabbage and sweet potato, cook until tender
Serve hot with steamed rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Sweet potato skins are edible — leave them on to reduce peel waste

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices if time allows
Sear chicken pieces until browned, then set aside
Saute garlic in butter, add tomato and garam masala, simmer into a sauce
Blend the sauce until smooth, then stir in cream
Return chicken to the sauce and simmer until cooked through
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe tomatoes blend down beautifully into the sauce base

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach briefly, then blend into a puree
Saute onion and garlic until soft
Add the spinach puree and simmer for a few minutes
Add cubed paneer and stir gently to coat
Finish with a swirl of cream and serve with rice or bread
recipes.sustainability_tip: Wilting spinach still purees beautifully — no need to discard it

recipes.name: Chana Masala
steps: Saute onion and garlic until golden
Add tomato and garam masala, cook into a thick sauce
Add chickpeas and a splash of water
Simmer for 15 minutes until the flavors meld
Serve hot with rice or flatbread
recipes.sustainability_tip: Canned chickpeas are shelf-stable and reduce fresh produce waste

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
steps: Boil lentils with turmeric until soft
In a separate pan, fry cumin seeds, garlic and onion until golden
Add tomato and cook until softened
Pour the tempering over the cooked lentils and stir
Simmer briefly and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Lentils are one of the most water-efficient proteins to cook with

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Saute onion and garlic with turmeric and cumin
Add potato and cauliflower florets
Stir to coat in the spices
Cover and cook until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally
Season and serve with flatbread or rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Cauliflower leaves are edible too — chop and cook them in

recipes.name: Classic Cheeseburger
steps: Shape ground beef into patties and season with salt and pepper
Grill or pan-fry patties to the desired doneness
Top with cheese in the last minute so it melts
Toast the buns lightly
Assemble with lettuce, tomato and onion
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use vegetable trimmings from the lettuce and tomato for a stock bag

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwich
steps: Slow-cook pork shoulder until it shreds easily with a fork
Shred the pork and mix with bbq sauce
Shred cabbage for a quick slaw
Toast the buns
Pile pork and slaw onto the buns and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Cheaper, tougher cuts of pork shoulder are ideal for slow cooking

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni until al dente and drain
Melt butter and whisk in flour to make a roux
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth and thickened
Stir in cheese until melted
Combine with the macaroni and serve hot
recipes.sustainability_tip: Use up small odds and ends of different cheeses in the sauce

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Wings
steps: Bake or fry chicken wings until crispy and cooked through
Melt butter and mix with hot sauce and minced garlic
Toss the cooked wings in the sauce until fully coated
Serve hot with celery sticks and a dipping sauce
recipes.sustainability_tip: Baking instead of deep-frying saves oil and energy

recipes.name: Clam Chowder
steps: Saute onion and celery until soft
Add diced potato and clam juice, simmer until potato is tender
Stir in milk and clams
Heat through gently without boiling
Season and serve with crusty bread
recipes.sustainability_tip: Choose sustainably harvested clams where available

recipes.name: Cornbread
steps: Mix cornmeal, flour, sugar and baking powder
Whisk in milk, egg and melted butter
Pour batter into a greased baking pan
Bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until golden
Cool slightly, slice and serve warm
recipes.sustainability_tip: Freeze leftover slices instead of letting them go stale and get thrown out

recipes.name: American Pancake Stack
steps: Whisk flour, sugar and baking powder together
Add egg and milk, whisk until just combined
Cook spoonfuls of batter in a buttered pan until bubbles form
Flip and cook until golden on both sides
Stack and serve with butter and maple syrup
recipes.sustainability_tip: Batter can be halved easily to avoid making more than you'll eat

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, bell pepper and onion into strips
Season chicken with fajita spices
Stir-fry chicken until cooked through, then set aside
Stir-fry the peppers and onion until just tender
Combine everything, squeeze over lime and serve with warm tortillas
recipes.sustainability_tip: Odd-shaped peppers work just as well here as perfect ones

recipes.name: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocado in a bowl to the desired texture
Finely dice tomato and onion and stir in
Add chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice
Season with salt to taste
Serve immediately with tortilla chips
recipes.sustainability_tip: Keep the avocado pit in the bowl to help slow browning of leftovers

recipes.name: Beef Burrito
steps: Brown the ground beef with taco seasoning
Warm the rice and beans
Lay a tortilla flat and layer beef, rice, beans and cheese
Fold in the sides and roll tightly
Warm in a dry pan seam-side down until sealed and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Leftover rice and beans from another meal work perfectly here

recipes.name: Mexican Rice
steps: Toast rice in a little oil until lightly golden
Add onion and garlic, cook until fragrant
Stir in chopped tomato and cumin
Add stock and simmer covered until rice is tender
Fluff with a fork and serve as a side
recipes.sustainability_tip: Very ripe tomatoes blend smoothly into the rice for extra flavor

recipes.name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Saute onion and garlic until soft
Add cumin and chopped tomato, cook briefly
Add black beans and stock, bring to a simmer
Blend partially for a creamy but chunky texture
Season and serve with a squeeze of lime
recipes.sustainability_tip: Dried or canned beans are a low-carbon, affordable protein source

recipes.name: Nasi Lemak
steps: Cook rice with coconut milk, pandan leaf and salt until fragrant
Fry the anchovies until crisp
Hard boil or fry the egg
Slice cucumber
Plate the rice with egg, cucumber, anchovies, peanuts and a spoon of sambal
recipes.sustainability_tip: Malaysia's national dish — cook only the rice you'll eat to avoid waste

recipes.name: Chicken Rendang
steps: Blend chili, garlic, ginger and lemongrass into a paste
Fry the paste until fragrant and oil separates
Add chicken and coat well in the paste
Pour in coconut milk and simmer, stirring occasionally
Cook low and slow until the sauce is thick and dark, then serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Rendang keeps and reheats well — cook a larger batch to save energy later

recipes.name: Mee Goreng
steps: Fry tofu cubes until golden and set aside
Scramble the egg in a hot wok and set aside
Stir-fry noodles with chili and soy sauce
Add bean sprouts and toss briefly
Return tofu and egg to the wok, mix through and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: A popular hawker-style dish that's flexible with whatever vegetables you have

recipes.name: Char Kway Teow
steps: Heat a wok until very hot and add oil
Stir-fry shrimp until just pink, set aside
Push noodles into the wok with soy sauce and chili, toss well
Push noodles aside and scramble the egg in the space
Add bean sprouts and shrimp back in, toss everything together and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: High wok heat cooks quickly, using less energy than slow simmering

recipes.name: Laksa
steps: Fry laksa paste (chili, garlic, lemongrass) until fragrant
Add coconut milk and stock, bring to a simmer
Add shrimp and tofu, cook until shrimp is pink
Cook rice noodles separately and place in bowls
Ladle the soup over the noodles and top with bean sprouts
recipes.sustainability_tip: Make a big pot and freeze the broth base in portions for later

recipes.name: Satay Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into strips and thread onto skewers
Marinate in turmeric, lemongrass and soy sauce
Grill skewers over high heat until charred and cooked through
Blend peanuts with soy sauce and a little water for the peanut sauce
Serve skewers with the peanut sauce and sliced cucumber
recipes.sustainability_tip: Soak wooden skewers in water and reuse metal ones to cut down on waste

recipes.name: Roti Canai
steps: Knead flour, salt and water into a soft dough
Coat the dough in butter and rest for at least 30 minutes
Stretch the dough as thin as possible
Fold into a square and rest briefly
Fry on a hot flat griddle until golden and flaky on both sides
recipes.sustainability_tip: Make a larger batch and freeze unfried dough balls to reduce future cooking energy

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry Puff
steps: Cook diced potato and peas with curry powder and onion until fragrant
Make or use ready pastry dough, cut into circles
Spoon filling onto each circle and fold into a half-moon, sealing the edges
Fry until golden and crisp, or bake at 200C for 20 minutes
Serve warm as a snack
recipes.sustainability_tip: Baking instead of deep-frying uses less oil and energy

recipes.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
steps: Cook quinoa according to packet instructions
Roast chickpeas with a little oil and spice until crisp
Shred carrot and wash spinach
Arrange quinoa, chickpeas, spinach and carrot in a bowl
Top with sliced avocado and a simple lemon dressing
recipes.sustainability_tip: A plant-based bowl like this has a much smaller carbon footprint than a meat-based meal

recipes.name: Vegan Lentil Curry
steps: Saute onion and garlic until soft
Add curry powder and cook until fragrant
Add lentils, coconut milk and water, simmer until lentils are tender
Stir in spinach until wilted
Season and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Lentils and coconut milk together make a filling, low-carbon protein source

recipes.name: Tofu Stir Fry
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry until golden on all sides
Set tofu aside and stir-fry garlic until fragrant
Add broccoli and carrot, stir-fry until crisp-tender
Return tofu to the pan and add soy sauce
Toss everything together and serve with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Tofu has a fraction of the water and carbon footprint of meat proteins

recipes.name: Vegan Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend oats into a coarse flour
Mash banana and mix with plant milk
Combine with the oat flour and baking powder into a batter
Cook spoonfuls in a lightly oiled pan until bubbles form, then flip
Cook until golden on both sides and serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Overripe bananas are ideal here and would otherwise go to waste

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad
steps: Cook quinoa and let it cool
Dice cucumber and tomato
Combine quinoa with the vegetables in a bowl
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper
Toss and serve chilled or at room temperature
recipes.sustainability_tip: Quinoa is a complete plant protein with a lower environmental footprint than meat

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Asparagus
steps: Trim the woody ends off the asparagus spears
Melt butter in a pan with minced garlic over medium heat
Add asparagus and saute until just tender, 5-7 minutes
Squeeze lemon juice over the top and season with salt
recipes.sustainability_tip: Woody asparagus ends make a good base for vegetable stock instead of being tossed

recipes.name: Roasted Root Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C
Peel and cut beetroot, turnip and carrot into even chunks
Toss with olive oil and salt on a baking tray
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and caramelized
recipes.sustainability_tip: Root vegetable peels and trimmings are great for a homemade stock bag in the freezer

recipes.name: Grapefruit Avocado Salad
steps: Peel and segment the grapefruit
Slice the avocado
Arrange over a bed of lettuce
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lime juice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Save avocado pits and grapefruit peel scraps for composting

recipes.name: Mixed Fruit Salad
steps: Halve the grapes
Peel and slice the kiwi
Cube the melon
Peel and segment the orange, then toss everything together in a bowl
recipes.sustainability_tip: Slightly overripe fruit is perfect here — sweeter and otherwise likely to be wasted

recipes.name: Tropical Fruit Bowl
steps: Peel and cube the papaya and pineapple
Halve the passion fruit and scoop out the pulp
Combine all the fruit in a bowl
Squeeze lime juice over the top and toss gently
recipes.sustainability_tip: Papaya seeds are edible and peppery — try them dried and ground as a pepper substitute

recipes.name: Stone Fruit Crumble
steps: Preheat the oven to 190C
Slice the peach, plum and nectarine into a baking dish
Sprinkle with cinnamon
Top with oats and bake for 20-25 minutes until the fruit is soft and the top is golden
recipes.sustainability_tip: Bruised or overripe stone fruit works perfectly once baked, so nothing needs to go to waste

recipes.name: Poached Pear
steps: Peel the pear, keeping the stem intact
Simmer water with honey, cinnamon and a squeeze of lemon juice
Add the pear and poach for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender
Let cool slightly in the liquid before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Pear peels can be steeped into a fragrant tea instead of thrown away

recipes.name: Pomegranate Quinoa Salad
steps: Cook quinoa and let it cool
Deseed the pomegranate
Toss quinoa with spinach and pomegranate seeds
Crumble feta over the top and dress with lemon juice
recipes.sustainability_tip: Pomegranate seeds freeze well — deseed a whole fruit at once to avoid waste

recipes.name: Radish and Cucumber Salad
steps: Thinly slice the radish and cucumber
Toss together in a bowl with chopped mint
Dress with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice
Season with salt and serve chilled
recipes.sustainability_tip: Radish greens are edible too — saute them like you would spinach instead of discarding

recipes.name: Leek and Potato Soup
steps: Slice the leek and dice the potato
Saute the leek in butter until soft
Add potato and enough water to cover, simmer until tender
Blend until smooth, stir in milk and season with salt
recipes.sustainability_tip: The dark green leek tops are edible — use them here instead of throwing them out

recipes.name: Sweetcorn Fritters
steps: Whisk egg with flour and a splash of water to make a batter
Stir in sweetcorn and chopped green onion
Season with salt
Fry spoonfuls in a hot oiled pan until golden on both sides
recipes.sustainability_tip: Leftover corn cobs make a surprisingly good stock base

recipes.name: Watermelon Feta Salad
steps: Cube the watermelon and remove any seeds
Toss with crumbled feta and torn mint leaves
Squeeze lime juice over the top
Serve immediately, chilled
recipes.sustainability_tip: Watermelon rind can be pickled instead of thrown away — see Waste Control for the recipe

recipes.name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
steps: Spiralize or julienne the zucchini into noodles
Blend basil, garlic, olive oil and parmesan into a pesto
Toss the zucchini noodles with the pesto
Serve immediately at room temperature or lightly warmed
recipes.sustainability_tip: Zucchini ends and trimmings can go straight into a vegetable stock bag

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer chicken breast in water with salt until cooked through, then shred and set aside
Add rice to the simmering broth and cook until tender
Whisk egg with lemon juice, then slowly whisk in a ladle of hot broth to temper it
Stir the tempered mixture back into the pot along with the shredded chicken
recipes.sustainability_tip: The poaching liquid from the chicken becomes the soup base — nothing extra needed

recipes.name: Tzatziki Dip
steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out excess water
Mix with yogurt, minced garlic and a squeeze of lemon
Stir in chopped mint
Chill for at least 15 minutes before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Squeezed-out cucumber liquid can go into a smoothie instead of down the drain

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Skillet
steps: Saute onion in olive oil until soft
Add spinach and cook until wilted
Make wells in the pan and crack in the eggs
Crumble feta over the top and cook until the eggs are just set
recipes.sustainability_tip: Wilted or slightly past-its-best spinach works perfectly here

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C
Cut potatoes into wedges and toss with olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic and oregano
Spread on a baking tray in a single layer
Roast for 35-40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and tender
recipes.sustainability_tip: Potato skins are nutritious — leave them on instead of peeling

recipes.name: Marinated Olives and Feta
steps: Cube the feta and combine with olives in a bowl
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and thinly sliced garlic together
Pour over the feta and olives and toss gently
Let marinate at least 30 minutes before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: The leftover marinating oil makes a great salad dressing base — don't pour it out

recipes.name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
steps: Brown chicken thigh pieces, then set aside
Saute onion and carrot in the same pot until softened
Stir in cumin and cinnamon, then return the chicken along with chickpeas, dried apricot and enough water to cover
Cover and simmer for 35-40 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened
recipes.sustainability_tip: This is a great way to use up chicken thighs nearing their use-by date

recipes.name: Moroccan Couscous with Vegetables
steps: Simmer carrot and zucchini with cumin and turmeric until just tender
Stir in chickpeas and heat through
Prepare couscous according to package directions
Spoon the vegetables and their broth over the couscous to serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Any vegetable odds and ends can go into the pot alongside the carrot and zucchini

recipes.name: Moroccan Spiced Carrots
steps: Slice carrots into batons
Toss with olive oil and cumin
Roast at 200C for 20-25 minutes until tender and lightly browned
Drizzle with honey before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Carrot tops can be turned into a pesto instead of being discarded — see Waste Control

recipes.name: Lamb and Chickpea Stew
steps: Brown lamb pieces in a pot, then set aside
Saute onion until soft, then stir in cumin and cinnamon
Return the lamb along with chickpeas, tomato and enough water to cover
Simmer covered for 1 hour, or until the lamb is tender
recipes.sustainability_tip: Tougher, cheaper cuts of lamb work perfectly in a long-simmered stew like this

recipes.name: Chickpea and Apricot Couscous
steps: Prepare couscous according to package directions
Warm chickpeas with a pinch of cinnamon
Fluff the couscous and fold in the chickpeas and chopped dried apricot
Drizzle with honey before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Dried fruit is a great way to use fruit that would otherwise spoil before being eaten fresh

recipes.name: Korean Pork Bulgogi
steps: Blend pear, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar into a marinade
Marinate thinly sliced pork for at least 30 minutes
Stir-fry the pork over high heat until browned and cooked through
Serve hot with rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: An overripe pear works fine blended into the marinade — no need for a perfect one

recipes.name: Korean Cucumber Salad
steps: Slice cucumber and salt lightly, then let sit 10 minutes and drain excess water
Toss with sesame oil, minced garlic and chopped chili
Sprinkle with sesame seeds
Serve chilled as a side dish
recipes.sustainability_tip: Slightly soft cucumbers are perfect here since they're salted and softened anyway

recipes.name: Korean Egg Roll
steps: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt
Stir in finely diced carrot and green onion
Pour a thin layer into a hot, lightly oiled pan and let set most of the way
Roll the omelette up from one edge, then slice into pinwheels
recipes.sustainability_tip: Any finely diced vegetable scraps can be folded into the egg mixture

recipes.name: Korean Spicy Pork Stir Fry
steps: Mix gochujang with minced garlic to make a sauce
Stir-fry sliced pork and onion over high heat until the pork is nearly cooked
Add the gochujang sauce and toss to coat
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil
recipes.sustainability_tip: This dish is very forgiving of odd-sized pork scraps and trimmings

recipes.name: Korean Seaweed Soup
steps: Saute thin strips of beef in sesame oil until browned
Add soaked, chopped seaweed and minced garlic, stir-fry briefly
Add water and soy sauce, then bring to a simmer
Simmer 15-20 minutes until the seaweed is tender
recipes.sustainability_tip: A traditional birthday-morning soup in Korea — a good way to use up dried seaweed sheets

recipes.name: Japanese Curry Udon
steps: Saute onion, carrot and chicken thigh until the chicken is browned
Add water and simmer until the vegetables are tender
Stir in curry roux until dissolved and the sauce thickens
Cook udon noodles separately, then ladle the curry over them
recipes.sustainability_tip: Vegetable odds and ends disappear easily into a simmered curry sauce

recipes.name: Tamagoyaki (Japanese Rolled Omelette)
steps: Whisk eggs with a little soy sauce and sugar
Pour a thin layer into a hot, lightly oiled pan
Once mostly set, roll it to one side, then pour more egg into the empty space and roll again
Repeat until all the egg is used, then slice and garnish with green onion
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up eggs before their date passes

recipes.name: Salmon Teriyaki
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, minced garlic and ginger into a sauce
Pan-sear the salmon skin-side down until crisp
Flip, then pour the sauce over and let it simmer and thicken
Spoon the glaze over the salmon before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: This glaze works just as well on salmon offcuts or smaller portions nearing their use-by date

recipes.name: Japanese Curry Rice
steps: Brown chicken thigh pieces, then set aside
Saute onion, carrot and potato until the onion softens
Return the chicken, add water to cover and simmer until the vegetables are tender
Stir in curry roux until dissolved and thickened, then serve over rice
recipes.sustainability_tip: A classic way to use up whatever vegetables are about to turn — carrot and potato are just the base

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
steps: Fry green curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant
Add the rest of the coconut milk and bring to a simmer
Add zucchini and bell pepper, simmer until tender
Stir in thai basil just before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Any vegetable nearing its use-by date works well simmered in curry sauce

recipes.name: Thai Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, minced garlic and chopped chili into a sauce, thinning with a little hot water
Toss the noodles with the sauce
Serve at room temperature or lightly warmed
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up the last of a peanut butter jar, including the scraped-out bits

recipes.name: Thai Mango Salad
steps: Julienne the mango into thin strips
Whisk lime juice, fish sauce and chopped chili into a dressing
Toss the mango with the dressing
Top with crushed peanuts before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: Slightly underripe mango actually works best here, giving it a firmer texture

recipes.name: Thai Basil Beef
steps: Stir-fry minced garlic and chili in a hot wok until fragrant
Add beef and stir-fry over high heat until browned
Season with fish sauce and soy sauce
Toss in thai basil off the heat until just wilted
recipes.sustainability_tip: Works well with cheaper, quick-cooking cuts of beef sliced thin

recipes.name: Chinese Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring water to a simmer and season with a pinch of salt and white pepper
Mix corn starch with a little cold water and stir into the simmering broth to thicken slightly
Slowly drizzle in beaten egg while stirring gently to form ribbons
Garnish with green onion before serving
recipes.sustainability_tip: A simple way to stretch a single egg into a full pot of soup

recipes.name: Chinese Garlic Green Beans
steps: Blanch or stir-fry green beans until just tender
Add minced garlic and stir-fry briefly until fragrant
Season with soy sauce
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil
recipes.sustainability_tip: Slightly limp green beans crisp back up nicely with a quick stir-fry

recipes.name: Chinese Scallion Pancakes
steps: Make a simple dough from flour, water and a pinch of salt, then rest for 20 minutes
Roll out thin, brush with sesame oil and scatter with chopped green onion, then roll up and coil into a spiral
Roll the spiral back out flat
Pan-fry in a little oil until golden and crisp on both sides
recipes.sustainability_tip: Uses up the green tops of onions that might otherwise be trimmed and binned

recipes.name: Chinese Braised Tofu
steps: Pan-fry cubed tofu until lightly golden on each side
Add minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry briefly
Add soy sauce, a pinch of sugar and enough water to just cover
Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce reduces slightly, then top with green onion
recipes.sustainability_tip: A gentle simmer like this is forgiving of tofu that's a day or two past its best

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
steps: Slowly caramelize thinly sliced onions in butter over low heat, about 30 minutes
Add water and thyme, then simmer for 15 minutes
Ladle into bowls and top with a slice of bread
Cover with cheese and grill or broil until melted and bubbling
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up onions that have started sprouting — they still caramelize perfectly

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Dice eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, tomato and onion
Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until fragrant
Add the remaining vegetables and simmer, stirring occasionally
Cook for 30-35 minutes until everything is soft and stew-like
recipes.sustainability_tip: The classic way to use up a glut of summer vegetables before they spoil

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Cook bacon and onion together until the bacon is crisp, then set aside
Whisk eggs with cream and a pinch of salt
Scatter the bacon, onion and cheese into a pie dish and pour the egg mixture over
Bake at 180C for 30-35 minutes until set and golden
recipes.sustainability_tip: A good way to use up the last bits of bacon and cheese before they go off

recipes.name: Croque Monsieur
steps: Spread mustard on one slice of bread and layer with ham and cheese
Top with a second slice of bread and butter the outside of both slices
Pan-fry until golden on one side, then flip
Cook until the second side is golden and the cheese has melted through
recipes.sustainability_tip: Perfect for using up the heel slices of a loaf that often get left behind

recipes.name: Spanish Tortilla
steps: Thinly slice potato and onion, then gently fry in olive oil until soft (not browned)
Drain and mix into beaten eggs with a pinch of salt
Pour back into a hot pan and cook until the bottom sets
Flip carefully and cook the other side until just set in the middle
recipes.sustainability_tip: A classic use for potatoes that have gone a little soft

recipes.name: Chicken and Chorizo Paella
steps: Brown chicken thigh and sliced chorizo in a wide pan, then set aside
Saute bell pepper in the rendered fat, then stir in paprika
Add rice and enough water to cover, then return the chicken and chorizo
Simmer without stirring until the rice is tender, adding peas in the last 5 minutes
recipes.sustainability_tip: The rendered fat from the chorizo flavors the whole dish, so nothing goes to waste

recipes.name: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop tomato, cucumber, bell pepper and onion
Blend with garlic, olive oil and a splash of vinegar until smooth
Season with salt and adjust the vinegar to taste
Chill for at least an hour before serving cold
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up very ripe or slightly bruised tomatoes

recipes.name: Patatas Bravas
steps: Cube potatoes and roast or fry until crisp and golden
Simmer tomato with garlic and paprika into a quick sauce
Season the sauce with salt to taste
Spoon the sauce over the hot potatoes to serve
recipes.sustainability_tip: Works well with potatoes that have started to soften and aren't ideal for other dishes

recipes.name: Vietnamese Pho-Style Beef Noodle Soup
steps: Char the onion and ginger, then simmer with star anise in water for 30 minutes to build the broth
Strain the broth and season with salt to taste
Cook rice noodles separately and divide into bowls
Top with thinly sliced raw beef (the hot broth will cook it), a squeeze of lime and cilantro
recipes.sustainability_tip: Onion skins and trimmings can go straight into the broth for extra flavor before straining

recipes.name: Vietnamese Rice Noodle Salad
steps: Cook rice noodles and rinse under cold water
Cook shrimp until pink and just cooked through
Whisk lime juice and fish sauce into a dressing
Toss the noodles, shrimp, lettuce, mint and cilantro with the dressing, then top with crushed peanuts
recipes.sustainability_tip: A good way to use up herbs before they wilt — they're used generously here

recipes.name: Vietnamese Caramel Pork
steps: Melt sugar in a pot until it turns a deep amber caramel
Carefully add pork pieces and toss to coat in the caramel
Add fish sauce, minced garlic and enough water to cover, then simmer for 30 minutes
Add boiled, peeled eggs in the last 10 minutes to soak up the sauce
recipes.sustainability_tip: A long braise like this turns tougher, cheaper cuts of pork tender and flavorful

recipes.name: Vietnamese Banh Mi
steps: Cook pork until browned and cooked through, then slice thinly
Quick-pickle julienned carrot in a little vinegar and sugar while the pork cooks
Split the bread and spread with mayonnaise
Layer in the pork, pickled carrot, cucumber, cilantro and sliced chili
recipes.sustainability_tip: A great way to use up leftover cooked pork from another meal
